html: † זַבַּי n.pr.m. (Palm. זבי VogNo. 28 (but this perhaps = loricatus, cf. ܙܰܒܳܐ lorica);* on Palm. זבי (prob. abbrev. from זבד …), v. Lzb 265 Cooke 273, 291. connex. with above √ uncertain)—Jew in Ezra’s time Ezr 10:28; 𝔊 Ζαβου(θ); cf. also Ne 3:20 Kt (𝔊 Ζαβου etc., but Qr זַכַּי v. זַכָּ֑י Ezr 2:9 = Ne 7:14).
